gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ off until Thursday.
gaps.explanation: 'Put off' = postpone to a later time.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The talks fell ___ when neither side would compromise on fishing rights.
gaps.explanation: 'Fall through' = (a plan or deal) fail to be completed.

gaps.sentence: Everyone says she takes ___ her grandmother.
gaps.explanation: take after a relative = resemble them in character/looks.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.
